decisions.reason: Proven government adoption and over 30 APIS connections show its value has largely resolved favourably, so the firm should commit further rather than abandon it.
The cyber awareness module is cheap to sustain using existing certified trainers and its uptake is still uncertain, so keeping it preserves the upside at little cost.
Passenger profiling draws on core aviation security expertise and costs little to keep, and without negative evidence the option stays open while its value emerges.

The verification platform sits close to the established offer with a dedicated page and low marginal cost, and it complements Product A's government data links, so it is retained, though the withdrawal of the related travel health API suggests some risk in this travel-data niche.
